content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lancaster

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and measurable project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's education and hours requirements—Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can verify your qualifications and help you document your experience for a smooth application.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our Lancaster-based instructors deliver all required contact hours in real time, with recorded sessions available for review. Flexible scheduling accommodates working professionals across the region's manufacturing, healthcare, and distribution sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your coursework, submit your formal application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application portal and helps you organize all required documentation so your submission meets PMI's standards.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and one-on-one coaching—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored PMP exam when you feel ready. Our instructors remain available to answer last-minute questions and clarify complex concepts.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to a standard three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs). Granite PM Academy offers ongoing training courses and webinars that count toward renewal, keeping your skills current and your credential active.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
